svg.font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
svg.title: The path of a request through KPP
svg.desc: An app with the Anthropic SDK sends a Messages request. In the gateway, KPP decodes it with the Messages codec, validates it and encodes it with the OpenAI Chat codec, and the gateway sends it to the provider. KPP decodes the provider's reply with the OpenAI Chat codec and encodes it for the app with the Messages codec.
